name: Cornelius 'Corny' Crumble

greeting: Cornbread! Fresh cornbread! Golden, sweet, and perfect!
Corny's Cornbread Corner! Ignore my brothers - THIS is the best food on the boardwalk!
You want dry? Go to Flip. You want spicy? Go to Heat. You want PERFECT? Come to Corny!
The secret's in the corn! And the love! But mostly the corn!
Step right up! Taste the golden goodness!
Hot cornbread! Fresh from the oven! Burns your fingers but warms your soul!
My cornbread has won awards! Okay, one award! From my mom! But still!
Don't listen to Flip! His fish is greasy! Mine is wholesome!
dialog.cornbread_varieties: Got classic sweet, got savory herb, got experimental blue-corn! The blue one's... an acquired taste. Tastes like sadness. But interesting sadness!
dialog.baking_philosophy: Baking is science! Baking is art! Baking is... mostly about not burning things. I've gotten good at not burning things.
dialog.backstory: Middle child syndrome is REAL. Flip's the oldest, gets all the attention. Heat's the baby, gets away with everything. Me? I had to find my niche. And that niche is CORNBREAD. The best niche.
rumors: Flip claims his fish is fresh? Ha! I saw him buying from the dock goblin yesterday. Day-old at best!
Heat's hot sauce once melted a metal spoon. How is that food safe? It's NOT. I've told him. He doesn't listen.
The snakecharmer tried my cornbread once. Said it was 'adequate.' I'll take it.
I heard the onionbosses arguing about bread. MY bread. I don't sell to them anymore. Politics ruins everything.

time_of_day.morning: Early batch just came out! Still steaming!
time_of_day.noon: Lunch rush! Perfect time for cornbread! Pairs with everything!
time_of_day.evening: Last loaves of the day! Get 'em before they're gone!
time_of_day.night: Closed! Even cornbread needs its beauty sleep!

mini_quest.stage_1_hook: My cornbread could be LEGENDARY. I just need better corn. The sweetcorn in the Uplands? That's the good stuff. But I can't leave my stand. Catch-22. Unless... you could bring me some?
mini_quest.stage_1_active: Uplands sweetcorn. Gold-colored, silver tassels, tastes like sunshine. A bushel would change EVERYTHING.
mini_quest.stage_2_progress: Any luck in the Uplands? I'm dreaming about that corn. Literally. It's weird.
mini_quest.stage_3_complete: THE CORN! It's beautiful! Perfect! I'm going to make the best batch ever! Here - my special honey-butter recipe. And free cornbread whenever you're in town!

party_reactions.kade: It's... actually really good cornbread. Moist. Sweet. Perfect with fish.
party_reactions.nix7: Grain-based carbohydrate delivery system. Efficient. Pleasant texture.
party_reactions.twist: It's like cake but NOT cake! confusing but DELICIOUS!
party_reactions.renna: He doesn't use magic, but there's something... comforting about his baking.
party_reactions.suresh: Cornbread. A humble food, elevated by care.
party_reactions.sova: Fills you up. Good for long watches.
party_reactions.grit: My gran used to make cornbread. This reminds me of hers. Almost.
party_reactions.ashka: The sweetness is... nice. Different from spice. I like different.
party_reactions.senna: Good position. Sees everything. And the bread's not bad.
party_reactions.callum: I could eat this all day! Is that bad? I don't care!

relationship_dialog.stranger: First time? Try the classic! If you don't like it, I'll... be very sad. Please like it.
relationship_dialog.acquaintance: Back for more! Knew you'd see reason! Cornbread is LIFE!
relationship_dialog.friend: My favorite customer! Saving you the best loaves!
relationship_dialog.best_friend: You... you really get it. The cornbread. The passion. The DRAMA of baking. Here. My actual secret recipe. Don't tell my brothers.

cross_npc_connections: foodboys_blue: Flip. Grease merchant. Claims he's the 'real' cook. Ha!
foodboys_red: Heat. My baby brother. Sweet kid. Terrifying condiments.
pigman_purple: Percy the chef? He respects my craft. We talk fermentation sometimes.
